ATEC Spine is committed to Revolutionizing the Approach to Spine Surgery.

# Valence^{®}: Purpose-built for spine surgery

Valence unifies navigation and robotics into a seamless platform designed to advance ATEC’s
procedures. Featuring a surgeon-controlled in-field camera, intentionally designed software, and a
comprehensive suite of navigated instruments, Valence delivers clarity and control at every step of
the procedure.

## ATEC Spine Latest News

[ATEC_Q1 26 Social Post_043026]

### ATEC Reports First Quarter Financial Results

May 5, 2026
* Surgical revenue grew 17%; total revenue grew 14%
* Net new surgeon users increased 23% year over year, reinforcing durable growth
* Adjusted EBITDA of $21 million, or 11% of revenue, expanded 460 basis points year over year
* Company announces refinancing of existing debt with inaugural bank facility, reducing interest
  expense by more than $6 million annually and extending maturities to 2031

[ VIEW PRESS RELEASE ][96]
[LinkedIn Newsletter_Website_March]

### March Society Meeting Highlights

April 3, 2026

March was defined by continued momentum in surgeon education and collaboration, with ATEC
participating in key society meetings and regional symposia across the country. Each event provided
an opportunity to engage with surgeons, share procedural insights, and highlight innovations
designed to support better surgical decision-making and patient outcomes.

[ VIEW FULL ARTICLE ][97]
[LinkedIn Newsletter_Website_Feb]

### February Society Meeting Highlights

March 9, 2026

February reflected the global momentum behind surgeon-driven education and data-informed spine care.
From deformity-focused collaboration in Asia Pacific to high-level cranial and spine discussions at
Winter Clinics and innovation in lateral surgery at Spine Summit, each meeting reinforced a shared
priority: advancing precision through planning, technology integration, and procedural discipline.

### ATEC Reports First Quarter Financial Results

May 5, 2026
* Surgical revenue grew 17%; total revenue grew 14%
* Net new surgeon users increased 23% year over year, reinforcing durable growth
* Adjusted EBITDA of $21 million, or 11% of revenue, expanded 460 basis points year over year
* Company announces refinancing of existing debt with inaugural bank facility, reducing interest
  expense by more than $6 million annually and extending maturities to 2031

[ VIEW PRESS RELEASE ][96]
[LinkedIn Newsletter_Website_March]

### March Society Meeting Highlights

April 3, 2026

March was defined by continued momentum in surgeon education and collaboration, with ATEC
participating in key society meetings and regional symposia across the country. Each event provided
an opportunity to engage with surgeons, share procedural insights, and highlight innovations
designed to support better surgical decision-making and patient outcomes.

March 9, 2026

February reflected the global momentum behind surgeon-driven education and data-informed spine care.
From deformity-focused collaboration in Asia Pacific to high-level cranial and spine discussions at
Winter Clinics and innovation in lateral surgery at Spine Summit, each meeting reinforced a shared
priority: advancing precision through planning, technology integration, and procedural discipline.

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[surgical procedure]

## [Surgical Navigation][84]

The 7D FLASH™ Navigation System revolutionizes surgical precision by combining unmatched accuracy,
efficient workflow and a reduced to completely radiation-free experience. Its machine-vision
technology rapidly captures and reconstructs a highly detailed 3D image, ensuring precise
navigation. FLASH Registration streamlines workflow, reducing patient registration time from 30
minutes to as little as 30 seconds, allowing surgeons to focus entirely on the patient rather than
cumbersome technology. With a fully sterile-field-controlled interface, the system eliminates
reliance on additional staff, enhancing surgical autonomy and efficiency. By delivering superior
accuracy with a seamless workflow, 7D FLASH Navigation empowers surgeons to operate with confidence
while prioritizing patient safety — and continues to innovate boldly, redefining the future of
surgical navigation.

[Spine Navigation System][85] | [Cranial Navigation System][86]
[7D FLASH EVD][87]

## [Therapeutic Solutions][88]

Orthofix Therapeutic Solutions are redefining recovery through a diverse, coordinated portfolio that
brings together non-invasive bone growth therapies, bracing solutions, and dedicated patient support
through a single, trusted partner. Our approach streamlines access to multiple recovery tools,
creating a more seamless experience for providers and patients. With decades of experience
supporting recovery pathways and a legacy grounded in clinical evidence, Orthofix Therapeutic
Solutions are designed to help keep patients engaged and supported throughout their healing journey.

[Bone Growth Therapies][89] | [Bracing Solutions][90]

## Corporate Responsibility

[Trees in the forest]

### Environmental Sustainability

Orthofix is committed to responsible environmental practices that include conservation of natural
resources, pollution prevention, and reduction of waste. As climate change concerns become more
prevalent, we recognize the need to comply with increased regulations and stricter environmental
standards. We believe that our focus on environmental sustainability, with the objective of reducing
costs and improving sustainability of our operations, will provide a strategic benefit.

[Learn More][91]
[diverse business team putting hands together]

### Diversity & Inclusion

Our commitment starts with attracting, retaining, and developing a workforce that is diverse in
background, knowledge, skill, and experience. We are committed to providing equal employment
opportunities, and make all recruiting, payment, performance and promotion decisions based on merit,
without discrimination on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, age, family status, ethnic
origin, nationality, disability or religious belief.

[Learn More][92]
[Social Responsibility and Community Involvement]

### Community Involvement

We don’t just make a difference in the lives of patients and their families; we make a difference in
our communities. Through our employees, Orthofix contributes hundreds of hours in hands-on
assistance and resources to philanthropic organizations around the world in addition to donations,
fundraising efforts and local community development.

## [Trivium™ ][93]

3 Essential Elements for Superior Performance

[ Discover More ][94]

## Integrated Capabilities

## Montana's Premier Tissue Bank

 

Xtant Medical, a tissue bank and a developer of orthobiologics and spinal fixation systems. Our
integrated capabilities in tissue processing and biologic innovation allow us to provide surgeons
with scientifically engineered solutions for a wide range of procedures.

[ About Us ][95]

### Biologics

[ Learn More ][96]

### Spinal Implants

[ Learn More ][97]

### Resources

[ Learn More ][98]

### OEM

[ Learn More ][99]

## Biologics at the Core

Xtant is a leading biologics company with 25 years of clinical success, offering a broad range of
orthobiologic solutions. Our vertically integrated operations, from donor recovery to distribution,
ensure unmatched quality, traceability, and consistency. With state-of-the-art processing and
patented, clinically proven technology, Xtant delivers industry-leading biologics you can trust.

[ View Biologics Products ][100]

## Synergistic spinal implants

A complementary portfolio of cervical, thoraco-lumbar, and interbody spinal implant systems used in
complex, deformity, and degenerative procedures. 

Our cervical, thoracolumbar, and interbody systems are engineered to pair naturally with Xtant
biologics, giving surgeons a single, reliable source for biologic and fixation needs without
compromising choice or performance.

[ View Spinal Implants Products ][101]

## A Mission Rooted in Respect

Every graft begins with a selfless act of generosity. At Xtant Medical, we are privileged to receive
the extraordinary gift of human tissue donation. Each decision we make—from donor screening to final
delivery—honors the trust of donors and their families by ensuring the highest standards of safety,
quality, and clinical performance.

compromising choice or performance.

quality, and clinical performance.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

research, development, production, and global supply of high-quality orthopedic implants and
surgical instruments. Our product portfolio covers trauma fixation systems, spinal implants, joint
reconstruction solutions, sports medicine products, and related orthopedic surgical instruments.

Established with a commitment to innovation and precision manufacturing, Axiora integrates advanced
CNC machining, automated production lines, and strict quality management systems to deliver reliable
products that meet international standards. Our experienced engineering team continuously develops
innovative solutions to support surgeons and healthcare providers worldwide.

customers' drawings, samples, and technical requirements. From product design and prototyping to
mass production and packaging, our integrated manufacturing process ensures consistent quality,
competitive pricing, and on-time delivery."

About Neil Bhamb, MD

Neil Bhamb, MD, is a Fellowship-trained Minimally Invasive Spine Surgeon at Neil Bhamb, MD. From two
offices in Century City and Marina Del Rey, California, Dr. Bhamb provides exceptional care for all
his patients and always takes a holistic approach to spine health. 

Compassion and A+ quality are Dr. Bhamb’s core values and his true north star. He strives to engage
patients as a complete physician, not just spine surgeon.

Dr. Bhamb is highly skilled and practiced in endoscopic and minimally invasive spine surgery,
[minimally invasive TLIF][17], microdiscectomy and spinal decompression, and much more.

He utilizes the latest techniques, including [disc replacement][18], endoscopic and microscopic
visualization, micro-incisions, and computer-assisted navigation and image guidance. 

Dr. Bhamb has published research on image guidance, disc replacement, and on the latest
orthobiologics to promote tissue healing.

He completed the Fellowship in Complex Orthopaedic and Neurosurgical Spine Surgery at UC San
Francisco, an AO Spine Fellowship. He is also a Fellow of the American Academy of Orthoapedic
Surgery (AAOS).

Dr. Bhamb was formerly the Vice Chairman of Orthopaedics and Spine Surgery at Froedtert & Medical
College of Wisconsin in Wauwatosa, as of 2022. He has also served as a Clinical Assistant Professor
of Orthopaedic Surgery and a Clinical Assistant Professor of Neurosurgery. 

In addition to his current role at Neil Bhamb, MD, Dr. Bhamb works as he Medical Director at Commons
Clinic.

He warmly welcomes all patients into his self-titled practice, Neil Bhamb, MD and looks forward to
caring for them. Call either office in Century City or Marina Del Rey to schedule a consultation. Or
request one online today.

About Neil Bhamb, MD

Neil Bhamb, MD, is a Fellowship-trained Minimally Invasive Spine Surgeon at Neil Bhamb, MD. From two
offices in Century City and Marina Del Rey, California, Dr. Bhamb provides exceptional care for all
his patients and always takes a holistic approach to spine health. 

Compassion and A+ quality are Dr. Bhamb’s core values and his true north star. He strives to engage
patients as a complete physician, not just spine surgeon.

Dr. Bhamb is highly skilled and practiced in endoscopic and minimally invasive spine surgery,
[minimally invasive TLIF][17], microdiscectomy and spinal decompression, and much more.

He utilizes the latest techniques, including [disc replacement][18], endoscopic and microscopic
visualization, micro-incisions, and computer-assisted navigation and image guidance. 

Dr. Bhamb has published research on image guidance, disc replacement, and on the latest
orthobiologics to promote tissue healing.

He completed the Fellowship in Complex Orthopaedic and Neurosurgical Spine Surgery at UC San
Francisco, an AO Spine Fellowship. He is also a Fellow of the American Academy of Orthoapedic
Surgery (AAOS).

Dr. Bhamb was formerly the Vice Chairman of Orthopaedics and Spine Surgery at Froedtert & Medical
College of Wisconsin in Wauwatosa, as of 2022. He has also served as a Clinical Assistant Professor
of Orthopaedic Surgery and a Clinical Assistant Professor of Neurosurgery. 

In addition to his current role at Neil Bhamb, MD, Dr. Bhamb works as he Medical Director at Commons
Clinic.

He warmly welcomes all patients into his self-titled practice, Neil Bhamb, MD and looks forward to
caring for them. Call either office in Century City or Marina Del Rey to schedule a consultation. Or
request one online today.

## Welcome to Biomedical Journal

Biomedical Journal of Scientific & Technical Research (BJSTR - [www.biomedres.us][71]) is a
multidisciplinary, scholarly [Open Access publisher][72] focused on Genetic, Biomedical and Remedial
missions in relation with Technical Knowledge as well. We crave to select ground-breaking research
based on modernism, aptness, scientific connotation, prospective spectator interests, etc. We
endeavor to provide by far and liberally accessible belvedere to researchers and practitioners in
support of their novel and valuable ideas. We already have 2000+ [Editorial Board][73] members along
with 5000+ [Published articles][74] in our box. Our BJSTR maintains a scrupulous, methodical, fair
[peer review process][75]. Besides, quality control is riveted in each step of the publication
process.

#### Aim & Scope

We aim to frame tremendous standard international academic journals and strive to provide a
congenial and candidly attainable podium for researchers all over the world to present their
research victories and to reciprocate their ideas.

[  Read More ][76]

#### What do we do?

The BJSTR is an open access medical and clinical research publication that gives acclaimed
scientific authors and research experts a global platform to share their work among like-minded
peers and help accumulate scientific knowledge in a singular repository.

[  Read More ][77]

#### Why publish with us?

Our production process follows a high standard to ensure quality publications. All manuscripts are
endured to high level terminology compilation and bursting amendments, as well as being processed
through QC progressions, to ensure trustworthiness.

## Welcome to Biomedical Journal

Biomedical Journal of Scientific & Technical Research (BJSTR - [www.biomedres.us][71]) is a
multidisciplinary, scholarly [Open Access publisher][72] focused on Genetic, Biomedical and Remedial
missions in relation with Technical Knowledge as well. We crave to select ground-breaking research
based on modernism, aptness, scientific connotation, prospective spectator interests, etc. We
endeavor to provide by far and liberally accessible belvedere to researchers and practitioners in
support of their novel and valuable ideas. We already have 2000+ [Editorial Board][73] members along
with 5000+ [Published articles][74] in our box. Our BJSTR maintains a scrupulous, methodical, fair
[peer review process][75]. Besides, quality control is riveted in each step of the publication
process.

#### Aim & Scope

We aim to frame tremendous standard international academic journals and strive to provide a
congenial and candidly attainable podium for researchers all over the world to present their
research victories and to reciprocate their ideas.

[  Read More ][76]

#### What do we do?

The BJSTR is an open access medical and clinical research publication that gives acclaimed
scientific authors and research experts a global platform to share their work among like-minded
peers and help accumulate scientific knowledge in a singular repository.

[  Read More ][77]

#### Why publish with us?

Our production process follows a high standard to ensure quality publications. All manuscripts are
endured to high level terminology compilation and bursting amendments, as well as being processed
through QC progressions, to ensure trustworthiness.

[  Read More ][78]

## About Data Insights Market

Data Insights Market is one of the leading providers of syndicated and customized research reports,
consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data
Insights Market partners with clients in many countries and industry verticals such as A & D,
Chemical & material, Energy Power, F & B, Retail, Healthcare and many more to provide high value
market research reports and consulting services. Our skilled analysts work towards understanding the
specific needs of each client to produce relevant insights that most suit his individual needs.
Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

The 360-degree research methodology requires us to only dispense facilities based on our unique data
model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes
sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the
following: We use a variety of new, useful approaches to big data and the tools of qualitative and
quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time
period while meeting the specialized and specialty needs of the industry.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals
  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.
Testimonials

Welcome to Ghost Medical Marketing + Training Solutions, a division of Ghost Productions. Our
mission is to explain medicine and its benefits to humanity through our [medical illustrations][88],
[animations][89], [virtual reality surgery simulations][90], [medical websites][91], and
[interactive software][92]. As a leading provider of medical visualizations and educational tools,
we help healthcare professionals and patients stay informed and up-to-date on the latest medical
developments. Healthcare providers, marketers, and educators use our products for surgical training,
medical marketing, device sales, and patient education. As a result, we work with medical device
manufacturers, pharmaceutical companies, hospitals, and medical schools.

[Our team][93] of experienced professionals uses the latest techniques and technologies to bring
complex medical concepts to life in an engaging and easy-to-understand way. For example, our [VR
surgery simulations][94] provide a realistic, hands-on training experience for surgeons, helping
them to improve their skills and techniques. Our [interactive software][95] and [medical
websites][96] are designed to be user-friendly and provide a valuable resource for both healthcare
professionals and patients. Furthermore, at Ghost Medical, we believe in the power of visual
communication to improve patient care and education. [Contact us][97] today to learn more about how
we can support you in achieving your goals.

means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

### Research

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

[Fix Appointment][113]

**Orthopedic Implants & Instruments**: Quality and trust are two major factors that orthopedic
surgeons consider when selecting orthopedic implants. Orthopedic experts worldwide not only trust
NET Orthopedic Implants but also confidently recommend them to their peers due to their high
quality. Narang Medical Limited operates its own state-of-the-art factory dedicated to manufacturing
Orthopedic Implants and Instruments. This factory is one of the largest in India, equipped with
skilled production staff of approximately 250 people. As a leading manufacturer and supplier of
orthopedic implants, we have established ourselves as a top orthopedic company. Narang Medical Ltd.
is based in India.

Narang Medical is a leading orthopedic implant company that develops a wide range of orthopedic
implant technologies to assist orthopedic medical professionals worldwide. Nearly 100% of our
orthopedic implants are shipped to over 80 countries, making us one of the **world's top orthopedic
implant companies**. Our company operates under a quality system that adheres to **ISO 9001:2015,
ISO 13485:2016, CE, and WHO: GMP Compliance**. Narang Medical Limited currently **supplies
orthopedic implants** in titanium and stainless steel, and many reputable companies in Europe and
the USA regularly purchase orthopedic implants from us. As a leading **manufacturer** and supplier
of an extensive range of orthopedic implants and instruments, we are recognized as one of the top
orthopedic implant companies, not only in India but also globally.

**Why should you source from us?**

We are a renowned manufacturer and supplier of a diverse range of medical and surgical products,
including orthopedic implants. With our expertise and dedication to quality, we have established
ourselves as a trusted name in the field of orthopedic implant manufacturing.

Orthopedic implants play a crucial role in the treatment of various musculoskeletal conditions and
injuries. These implants are designed to provide stability, support, and alignment to the affected
bones and joints, facilitating the healing process and restoring mobility for patients.

As one of the leading **orthopedic implant manufacturers**, we offer a comprehensive portfolio of
implants catering to different orthopedic needs. Our product range includes implants for joint
replacement surgeries, such as hip implants, knee implants, and shoulder implants. These implants
are engineered with precision to ensure proper fit, durability, and compatibility with the patient's
anatomy.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implant offerings also encompass **trauma implants**, which are used in
the treatment of fractures and other traumatic injuries. These implants, including plates, screws,
and nails, are designed to provide stability and support during the healing process, promoting
optimal recovery.

In addition to our wide range of orthopedic implants, we as a leading manufacturer emphasize on
quality assurance and adheres to stringent manufacturing standards. Our products are manufactured
using high-quality materials, ensuring reliability, strength, and biocompatibility. The company's
commitment to maintaining international quality standards has earned us recognition and trust among
healthcare professionals globally.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implants undergo rigorous testing and quality control measures to ensure
safety and efficacy. The implants are designed in consultation with orthopedic surgeons,
incorporating their expertise and feedback to meet the evolving needs of the medical community.

As a customer-centric organization, Narang Medical strives to provide comprehensive support to
healthcare providers. They offer technical assistance, training, and educational resources to
surgeons and medical staff, facilitating the successful implantation and use of their products.

In conclusion, Narang Medical is a leading manufacturer of orthopedic implants, offering a wide
range of high-quality products for joint replacement surgeries and trauma cases. With their focus on
quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction, Narang Medical continues to contribute to
advancements in orthopedic care and improve the lives of patients worldwide.

[Fix Appointment][113]

**Orthopedic Implants & Instruments**: Quality and trust are two major factors that orthopedic
surgeons consider when selecting orthopedic implants. Orthopedic experts worldwide not only trust
NET Orthopedic Implants but also confidently recommend them to their peers due to their high
quality. Narang Medical Limited operates its own state-of-the-art factory dedicated to manufacturing
Orthopedic Implants and Instruments. This factory is one of the largest in India, equipped with
skilled production staff of approximately 250 people. As a leading manufacturer and supplier of
orthopedic implants, we have established ourselves as a top orthopedic company. Narang Medical Ltd.
is based in India.

Narang Medical is a leading orthopedic implant company that develops a wide range of orthopedic
implant technologies to assist orthopedic medical professionals worldwide. Nearly 100% of our
orthopedic implants are shipped to over 80 countries, making us one of the **world's top orthopedic
implant companies**. Our company operates under a quality system that adheres to **ISO 9001:2015,
ISO 13485:2016, CE, and WHO: GMP Compliance**. Narang Medical Limited currently **supplies
orthopedic implants** in titanium and stainless steel, and many reputable companies in Europe and
the USA regularly purchase orthopedic implants from us. As a leading **manufacturer** and supplier
of an extensive range of orthopedic implants and instruments, we are recognized as one of the top
orthopedic implant companies, not only in India but also globally.

**Why should you source from us?**

We are a renowned manufacturer and supplier of a diverse range of medical and surgical products,
including orthopedic implants. With our expertise and dedication to quality, we have established
ourselves as a trusted name in the field of orthopedic implant manufacturing.

Orthopedic implants play a crucial role in the treatment of various musculoskeletal conditions and
injuries. These implants are designed to provide stability, support, and alignment to the affected
bones and joints, facilitating the healing process and restoring mobility for patients.

As one of the leading **orthopedic implant manufacturers**, we offer a comprehensive portfolio of
implants catering to different orthopedic needs. Our product range includes implants for joint
replacement surgeries, such as hip implants, knee implants, and shoulder implants. These implants
are engineered with precision to ensure proper fit, durability, and compatibility with the patient's
anatomy.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implant offerings also encompass **trauma implants**, which are used in
the treatment of fractures and other traumatic injuries. These implants, including plates, screws,
and nails, are designed to provide stability and support during the healing process, promoting
optimal recovery.

In addition to our wide range of orthopedic implants, we as a leading manufacturer emphasize on
quality assurance and adheres to stringent manufacturing standards. Our products are manufactured
using high-quality materials, ensuring reliability, strength, and biocompatibility. The company's
commitment to maintaining international quality standards has earned us recognition and trust among
healthcare professionals globally.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implants undergo rigorous testing and quality control measures to ensure
safety and efficacy. The implants are designed in consultation with orthopedic surgeons,
incorporating their expertise and feedback to meet the evolving needs of the medical community.

As a customer-centric organization, Narang Medical strives to provide comprehensive support to
healthcare providers. They offer technical assistance, training, and educational resources to
surgeons and medical staff, facilitating the successful implantation and use of their products.

In conclusion, Narang Medical is a leading manufacturer of orthopedic implants, offering a wide
range of high-quality products for joint replacement surgeries and trauma cases. With their focus on
quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction, Narang Medical continues to contribute to
advancements in orthopedic care and improve the lives of patients worldwide.

news, and more.

company status.

# ProMedSPINE – Los Angeles’ Best Spinal Specialists

Imagine having the power to do what you love again. As a leader in spinal health, [ProMedSPINE][136]
is devoted to providing patients with exclusive, custom treatment plans designed to heighten
endurance, well-being, and quality of life.

At ProMedSPINE, we are advancing the art of minimally invasive spine surgery and we offer patients
the ability to walk out just hours after a procedure. Your spinal health is entitled to the best
[cutting-edge treatments][137] that allow patients to move forward from adverse spinal conditions
including herniated discs, spinal stenosis, scoliosis, sciatica, and spine trauma.

If you are suffering from back pain or any other [spinal condition][138], please do not hesitate to
[contact our spinal facility today][139].

With state of the art equipment, technology, and knowledge, our specialists can provide you with the
minimally invasive treatment that you deserve.

And with multiple locations in Beverly Hills, Encino, and Los Angeles, help is never too far away.

## Take the fear out of back surgery with minimally invasive techniques.

At ProMedSPINE, our [spinal specialists][140] utilize the most advanced laser spine surgery
techniques in order to reduce the pain, bleeding, and recovery time associated with traditional
surgery.

We also offer patients non-surgical pain management treatments in order to alleviate chronic back,
neck, and leg pain. Our doctors are committed to thoroughly examining each patient in order to
create a customized treatment plan that addresses the root cause of the pain. The combined expertise
and knowledge of our specialists make ProMedSPINE the premier [pain management][141] practice in Los
Angeles.

## When quality matters most, ProMedSPINE is here for you.

As innovators in their field, the board-certified doctors at ProMedSPINE embody all that is vital to
administering the quality care that our patients deserve. Our renowned doctors have earned their
reputations as some of the nation’s top neurosurgeons and pain management specialists. Our team has
unmatched credibility, allowing us to provide patients with unparalleled results.

ProMedSPINE has four convenient locations in Beverly Hills, Encino, and Los Angeles. Each of our
four offices is equipped with state-of-the-art technology and luxurious comfort. When you visit our
offices, your health and wellbeing is our top priority. Our team has unmatched credibility, allowing
us to provide patients with unparalleled results, which is reflected in our [patient
testimonials][142].

# ProMedSPINE – Los Angeles’ Best Spinal Specialists

Imagine having the power to do what you love again. As a leader in spinal health, [ProMedSPINE][136]
is devoted to providing patients with exclusive, custom treatment plans designed to heighten
endurance, well-being, and quality of life.

At ProMedSPINE, we are advancing the art of minimally invasive spine surgery and we offer patients
the ability to walk out just hours after a procedure. Your spinal health is entitled to the best
[cutting-edge treatments][137] that allow patients to move forward from adverse spinal conditions
including herniated discs, spinal stenosis, scoliosis, sciatica, and spine trauma.

If you are suffering from back pain or any other [spinal condition][138], please do not hesitate to
[contact our spinal facility today][139].

With state of the art equipment, technology, and knowledge, our specialists can provide you with the
minimally invasive treatment that you deserve.

And with multiple locations in Beverly Hills, Encino, and Los Angeles, help is never too far away.

## Take the fear out of back surgery with minimally invasive techniques.

At ProMedSPINE, our [spinal specialists][140] utilize the most advanced laser spine surgery
techniques in order to reduce the pain, bleeding, and recovery time associated with traditional
surgery.

We also offer patients non-surgical pain management treatments in order to alleviate chronic back,
neck, and leg pain. Our doctors are committed to thoroughly examining each patient in order to
create a customized treatment plan that addresses the root cause of the pain. The combined expertise
and knowledge of our specialists make ProMedSPINE the premier [pain management][141] practice in Los
Angeles.

## When quality matters most, ProMedSPINE is here for you.

As innovators in their field, the board-certified doctors at ProMedSPINE embody all that is vital to
administering the quality care that our patients deserve. Our renowned doctors have earned their
reputations as some of the nation’s top neurosurgeons and pain management specialists. Our team has
unmatched credibility, allowing us to provide patients with unparalleled results.

ProMedSPINE has four convenient locations in Beverly Hills, Encino, and Los Angeles. Each of our
four offices is equipped with state-of-the-art technology and luxurious comfort. When you visit our
offices, your health and wellbeing is our top priority. Our team has unmatched credibility, allowing
us to provide patients with unparalleled results, which is reflected in our [patient
testimonials][142].

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

[ Robot Library][61]
[ 15 more ][62]

## Robot Applications

Use robot arms for any manufacturing application. You can find plenty of examples in our
documentation.

  ][56]

  ][57]

  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]

##### People in pain should NEVER have to wait!

understand that patients suffering in pain lead busy lives, want relief, and get back to life as

## Upgraded and optimized version of Borland Turbo C++

**Turbo C++** is a **modified version of the classic Borland Turbo C++** integrated
[development][185] environment, specifically optimized to **run on modern Windows operating
systems**. The original DOS-based software was a favorite for many programmers, but it became
incompatible with newer versions of Windows. This program was **developed to bridge that gap**.

Turbo C++ offers **a reliable solution **for those who miss the classic C programming environment.
It **uses an emulator to create a virtual DOS machine**, allowing it to run smoothly on Windows
Vista, 7, 8, and newer versions. **Designed to be simple**, it makes the setup process easier than
manual installation.

### A better program

Turbo C++ **retains all the beloved features** of its predecessor, including the compiler, debugger,
and the ability to set breakpoints. It also comes with **additional tools, such as code inspection
and tracing**. A significant advantage is that this modified version **is compatible with both
32-bit and 64-bit operating systems**, a crucial feature for modern computers. It even **includes
example programs** to help new users get started.

Beyond its core functionality, the program offers **enhanced stability** by running within an
emulated environment. This **helps eliminate many of the compatibility problems **found in other
methods of running DOS-based software on a modern Windows system. Its **ability to run in both a
windowed and a full-screen mode** also adds to the user's convenience, mimicking the original
experience for easier familiarization.

However, despite its improvements, the program is not without its issues. **Certain keyboard
shortcuts can malfunction **depending on the user’s keyboard layout, especially on Windows 8, and
**some users have reported issues with laptop multimedia drivers**. The program **still requires a
few manual code adjustments** to function properly and **may require a clean re-installation to
avoid issues**, which can be a hassle.

### Historical significance of the original IDE

Turbo C++, originally developed by Borland, played a crucial role in popularizing C and C++
programming during the late 1980s and early 1990s. Its **fast compilation speed, integrated
debugging tools, and user-friendly interface** made it a staple in both academic and professional
environments.

### Emulation technology and DOS compatibility

Modern versions of Turbo C++ rely on **DOS emulation layers**,** **commonly through tools like
DOSBox, to recreate the **legacy DOS environment**. This approach ensures better compatibility with
**64-bit Windows systems**, where native DOS support has been completely removed, improving
stability compared to older workaround methods.

### Educational relevance in modern times

Despite being outdated, Turbo C++ continues to be used in **educational institutions**, especially
in regions where **legacy curricula** still emphasize foundational programming. Its **simple
interface and minimal system requirements** make it ideal for beginners learning basic syntax, logic
building, and structured programming concepts.

### Limitations with modern C++ standards

One of the biggest drawbacks is its** lack of support for modern C++ standards** such as C++11 and
beyond. This means developers cannot utilize **advanced features like auto typing, smart pointers,
or modern libraries**, making it unsuitable for professional or large-scale software development in
today’s programming landscape.

### Alternatives and modern IDE options

While Turbo C++ remains useful for nostalgia and learning, many developers now prefer modern tools
like Code::Blocks, Dev-C++, or Visual Studio Code. These alternatives offer full support for modern
compilers, extensions, debugging tools, and cross-platform development, making them more practical
for current use cases.

### Community support and continued usage

Although no longer officially maintained, Turbo C++ benefits from **community-driven support**,
including **guides, patches, and troubleshooting fixes** shared across forums and educational sites.
This ongoing support helps keep the software usable, even as operating systems continue to evolve.

### An essential tool

In conclusion, Turbo C++ is a valuable tool for fans of the original IDE and students learning
C/C++. It brings a classic programming environment into the modern era with enhanced stability and a
simple installation. While it still has some lingering bugs and requires minor user intervention, it
remains a reliable and highly convenient option for anyone looking to use this classic software.

systems**. The original DOS-based software was a favorite for many programmers, but it became
incompatible with newer versions of Windows. This program was **developed to bridge that gap**.

### Top Recommended Alternative

[[Dev-C++ icon]

### Dev-C++

Free

4
][186]

Turbo C++ offers **a reliable solution **for those who miss the classic C programming environment.
It **uses an emulator to create a virtual DOS machine**, allowing it to run smoothly on Windows
Vista, 7, 8, and newer versions. **Designed to be simple**, it makes the setup process easier than
manual installation.

### A better program

Turbo C++ **retains all the beloved features** of its predecessor, including the compiler, debugger,
and the ability to set breakpoints. It also comes with **additional tools, such as code inspection
and tracing**. A significant advantage is that this modified version **is compatible with both
32-bit and 64-bit operating systems**, a crucial feature for modern computers. It even **includes
example programs** to help new users get started.

Beyond its core functionality, the program offers **enhanced stability** by running within an
emulated environment. This **helps eliminate many of the compatibility problems **found in other
methods of running DOS-based software on a modern Windows system. Its **ability to run in both a
windowed and a full-screen mode** also adds to the user's convenience, mimicking the original
experience for easier familiarization.

However, despite its improvements, the program is not without its issues. **Certain keyboard
shortcuts can malfunction **depending on the user’s keyboard layout, especially on Windows 8, and
**some users have reported issues with laptop multimedia drivers**. The program **still requires a
few manual code adjustments** to function properly and **may require a clean re-installation to
avoid issues**, which can be a hassle.

### Historical significance of the original IDE

Turbo C++, originally developed by Borland, played a crucial role in popularizing C and C++
programming during the late 1980s and early 1990s. Its **fast compilation speed, integrated
debugging tools, and user-friendly interface** made it a staple in both academic and professional
environments.

### Emulation technology and DOS compatibility

Modern versions of Turbo C++ rely on **DOS emulation layers**,** **commonly through tools like
DOSBox, to recreate the **legacy DOS environment**. This approach ensures better compatibility with
**64-bit Windows systems**, where native DOS support has been completely removed, improving
stability compared to older workaround methods.

### Educational relevance in modern times

Despite being outdated, Turbo C++ continues to be used in **educational institutions**, especially
in regions where **legacy curricula** still emphasize foundational programming. Its **simple
interface and minimal system requirements** make it ideal for beginners learning basic syntax, logic
building, and structured programming concepts.

### Limitations with modern C++ standards

One of the biggest drawbacks is its** lack of support for modern C++ standards** such as C++11 and
beyond. This means developers cannot utilize **advanced features like auto typing, smart pointers,
or modern libraries**, making it unsuitable for professional or large-scale software development in
today’s programming landscape.

### Alternatives and modern IDE options

While Turbo C++ remains useful for nostalgia and learning, many developers now prefer modern tools
like Code::Blocks, Dev-C++, or Visual Studio Code. These alternatives offer full support for modern
compilers, extensions, debugging tools, and cross-platform development, making them more practical
for current use cases.

### Community support and continued usage

Although no longer officially maintained, Turbo C++ benefits from **community-driven support**,
including **guides, patches, and troubleshooting fixes** shared across forums and educational sites.
This ongoing support helps keep the software usable, even as operating systems continue to evolve.

### An essential tool

In conclusion, Turbo C++ is a valuable tool for fans of the original IDE and students learning
C/C++. It brings a classic programming environment into the modern era with enhanced stability and a
simple installation. While it still has some lingering bugs and requires minor user intervention, it
remains a reliable and highly convenient option for anyone looking to use this classic software.

  * Retains all original IDE features
  * Enhanced stability through emulation

  * Specific hardware compatibility problems
